name: Electron Microscopy & Microanalysis
summary: Covers scanning and transmission electron microscopy and the analytical methods that image and analyse materials down to single atoms.

topics.name: Electron optics: sources, lenses, aberrations and resolution
Electron-specimen interactions: secondary, backscattered and characteristic X-ray signals
Scanning electron microscopy: imaging modes, contrast and fractography
Energy- and wavelength-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS/WDS) and electron probe microanalysis
Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD): orientation maps, grain boundaries and texture
Focused ion beam (FIB): cross-sectioning, TEM lamella preparation and serial sectioning
Transmission electron microscopy: bright field, dark field and diffraction contrast
Imaging dislocations and defects: g·b analysis
High-resolution TEM and aberration-corrected STEM (HAADF, Z-contrast)
In-situ TEM, cryo-EM of materials and 4D-STEM
